locations.name: Aldani Basin & The Sharkmaw Underborn
locations.description:
Who They Are
The Sharkmaw Underborn are brutal sahuagin barons dwelling in Chult's lightless underworld, a savage evolution of oceanic raiders who fled surface storms centuries ago via flooded crevices. Their hides are pallid gray etched with bioluminescent blood-runes, fins razor-edged from constant ritual scarring, and jaws lined with serrated fangs that regenerate in blood-soaked waters. No noble coral thrones—just nomadic war-packs haunting submerged caverns, surfacing through sinkholes to raid the Aldani Basin's swamps.
Territory & Sacred Places
Confined to the eternal dark below, emerging via hidden vents:

The Abyss Lake: A vast underground sea beneath the Aldani Basin, 2 miles wide, fed by sunken rivers and glowing with phosphorescent fungi.
The Fangspire: Jagged obsidian pillars rising from the lake bed, altars for shark-god sacrifices.
Surge-Vents: Geysers and sinkholes piercing the basin's muddy surface, ambush points for raids.

Core Beliefs & Agenda

The depths demand blood tribute; weakness is devoured by the eternal shark-spirits (Sekolah twisted with Dendar's hunger).
Swamp-dwellers are "mud-prey" fouling the pure waters; cull them to purify the surge.
The Great Upwelling (Dendar leaks as shark-god awakening) will flood the basin, claiming it for the Underborn.
Inferior packs are ritually culled; survivors breed stronger spawn.

Leadership
Proven in the Trial of the Blood Frenzy: wrestle frenzied sharks bare-handed.

Kreshnak Bloodjaw – Baroness with a jaw grafted from a giant shark; one-eyed from Bloodscale rivalry.
Vyrssk Gillrend – Blind tide-priest who "smells" surface incursions; trident of petrified coral fangs.
Ssrak Surgefin – Hatchling prodigy with venomous spines; commands a pet cave megalodon juvenile.

Typical War-Packs

Sharkmaw Reavers (sahuagin barbarians with spear-multiattacks and blood-frenzy grapples)
Depth-Stalkers (rogues mimicking lake debris, nets laced with cave-jelly venom)
Finned Terrors (tamed blind cave sharks armored in scavenged bone)
Drowned Prey (gill-slashed thralls from basin raids, berserk in shallows)

How They Interact with Others

Aldani Basin Tribes (e.g., Verdant Schism): Emerge from vents to slaughter "plant-foulers," stealing shambling mounds for shark bait.
Bloodscale River-Born: Riverine blood-feud; block vents to starve lizardfolk hunts.
Nightscale Brood: Shadow-scavengers raid their sinkholes for "tainted meat"; uneasy detente over shared Dendar omens.
Veilborn Kinship: Elves' tree-villages over vents are prime targets—fey blood "sweetens the depths."
Zhentarim Smugglers: Capsize basin boats, extort "depth toll" or drag crews below.

Rituals & Traditions

Blood Frenzy: Post-raid, pods gorge on gill-slashed captives in the Abyss Lake—survivors frenzy stronger.
Spawn Culling: Hatchlings fight for baron's favor; losers feed the Fangspire sharks.
Upwelling Chant: Lunar convergences at vents, invoking the Great Upwelling with drowned bone drums.

The Sharkmaw Underborn turn every basin sinkhole into a gateway to watery doom. When vents bubble black and fish flee, the depths have risen.
